title: Depth, Contrast, Type, Ink & Tint
description: A scroll-driven CRT flythrough, a forced-colors-proof dashboard, a live OpenType lab, pointer-coalesced drawing, and the new AccentColor system color.

drops.title: CRT Flythrough
drops.description: Scroll through a wall of twenty synthesized CRT monitors flying past in 3D, each running its own live scanline or plasma pattern.
drops.concept: Camera depth is driven entirely by one 0–1 scroll-progress value: each screen's translateZ, rotation and opacity are recomputed from that single number every frame, no scroll-jacking library involved. Every CRT's picture is a small canvas synthesizer (scanline sweep, plasma field, static noise, or a shifting grid) rendered live, not a static image.
drops.source: tympanus/codrops — "Sixty Frames for the Record: A Three.js Game, Seven Fly-Throughs, and a Wall of CRTs"

interaction.mouse: Scroll to fly forward through the screen wall

drops.title: Forced-Colors Dashboard
drops.description: An ops dashboard built only from CSS system-color keywords, so it degrades gracefully — by design — under Windows High Contrast mode.
drops.concept: Inside a forced-colors media query, every border, badge and button is redeclared using Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, HighlightText and LinkText instead of the page's own palette. A live status banner reports the visitor's real forced-colors state via matchMedia, and a manual 'Simulate' toggle mirrors the same rules for visitors without high-contrast mode enabled.
drops.source: MDN Web Docs — forced-colors media feature and <system-color> reference

interaction.mouse: Click 'Simulate forced-colors' to preview the adapted palette
interaction.click: Toggles the simulation and the restart/incident buttons

drops.title: Feature Foundry
drops.description: A live OpenType feature lab — toggle ligatures, small caps, old-style figures and fractions and watch real font-feature-settings rewrite itself.
drops.concept: Checkboxes for liga/dlig, smcp/c2sc, four figure styles, fractions, slashed zero and sub/superscript each map straight to a 4-letter OpenType feature tag. Toggling any of them regenerates the actual font-feature-settings declaration applied to the live sample text, with a one-click copy of the generated CSS.
drops.source: Typotheque — "OpenType features in CSS" by Gustavo Ferreira

interaction.mouse: Click checkboxes to toggle OpenType features
interaction.click: Copy CSS button copies the generated declaration

drops.title: Coalesced Ink
drops.description: Freehand drawing that compares naive pointermove sampling against getCoalescedEvents() — corners visibly smooth out in real time.
drops.concept: In 'naive' mode, only the event's own final position is drawn each pointermove — fast strokes cut corners. In 'coalesced' mode, PointerEvent.getCoalescedEvents() replays every raw sample the OS captured since the last frame, so the same fast stroke draws through its true path. A live counter shows move-events vs. points-drawn to make the ratio tangible.
drops.source: nutrient.io blog — "Smoother Interactions on the Web: getCoalescedEvents()"

interaction.mouse: Draw by dragging; switch modes with the toolbar buttons
interaction.click: Clear canvas button resets the drawing
interaction.touch: Full touch/stylus support via Pointer Events

drops.title: Tinted Controls
drops.description: A settings panel where checkboxes, radios, sliders, selection and focus rings all key off one variable — including the new AccentColor system color.
drops.concept: Every interactive control uses accent-color: var(--tint) and a matching ::selection/focus-visible ring. A dedicated swatch requests the browser's real AccentColor / AccentColorText system colors via @supports, honestly explaining Chrome 150's installed-PWA-only privacy restriction rather than pretending the demo always shows your literal desktop accent.
drops.source: Chrome for Developers — Chrome 150 release notes (AccentColor / AccentColorText)

interaction.mouse: Click a swatch to retint every control on the page
interaction.click: Toggle checkboxes/radios/slider to see the tint applied live
